basis: Native blind cardinals passed; actual independent ordered-loop semantics have no failed direction
warnings: vertical-4 A vertical axis is ambiguous
independent_review: The head and upper neck turn through a coherent clockwise sequence while torso, feet, wings and tail remain planted and consistently oriented. Cardinal up/right/down/left are clear; intermediate poses stay ordered and mostly readable. Crest and whiskers remain connected. The 112.5 down-right pitch is shallow and independently ambiguous on vertical blind review, so it is recorded as a warning.

directions.observed: Definite up: centered crest and muzzle point vertically away; body axis remains upright.
directions.horizontal_evidence: No strong horizontal lead at the cardinal.
directions.vertical_evidence: Vertical cardinal is clear from skull/crest orientation.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Nose centered on head/neck axis; highest facial point above jaw.

directions.observed: Up-right: muzzle leads right with a slight upward pitch.
directions.reason: Clockwise turn begins without torso rotation.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Nose right of neck centerline and above eye line.

directions.reason: Ordered intermediate pose; still in upper-right quadrant.
